entry.name: Generative AI Fundamentals in Python
entry.note: A short project-based path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Developers who want hands-on practice with LLM APIs

covers: Python basics: variables, loops, conditionals, data structures
Working with large language models through APIs
AI chatbots and their real-world uses
Object-oriented programming, decorators, regular expressions, error handling
Command-line tools, virtual environments, Git and IDEs
APIs and web scraping for AI applications
Building interactive web apps with Streamlit
reading.format: An online path of courses with interactive lessons, hands-on exercises and projects. A certificate is earned on completion.
reading.summary: This is a Dataquest skill path that teaches Python for generative AI work. It begins with Python basics and moves through APIs, prompt engineering, large language models and Streamlit. Learners finish by building working AI-powered applications. Completing the path earns a certificate that can be added to a resume or LinkedIn profile.
reading.audience: The page says it is for anyone who wants to bring AI capabilities into their work, and for professionals who want to add AI to their toolkit.
